scope: Runtime Unity/PhysX camera interaction and HoldFix port regressions. Explicit prepared fixtures isolate optical, rack, bridge, current, high-deck and enlarged EXIT mechanisms. Corridor traversal and ending run via normal Tick movement. Images are explicit camera renders; hidden-window IMGUI capture is unavailable. This is not an unassisted full-map solve or a human difficulty/FPS benchmark.
